payload.reason: The evidence clearly indicates that LSTM and GRU with Attention outperform other models in offensive language identification tasks, making it the best-performing method.

claims.text: LSTM and GRU with Attention outperformed all other models in terms of macro-F1, precision, recall, and F1 for both Offensive and Not Offensive classes.
Among classical machine learning approaches, the Linear SVM achieved the best results with a macro-F1 of 0.80, but it was not as effective as the deep learning models.
The Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGDC) yielded the best recall score for the Offensive class at 0.61 among classical models, but still underperformed compared to deep learning methods.
